name: base_utils
description: Manages common host utilities, including an optional MOTD, configurable utility packages, and supporting custom types, functions, facts, tasks, and health/restart operations.

name: profile_app_stack
description: Deploys and configures the full Python application stack, including the runtime, repository, PostgreSQL connection settings, systemd service, logging, health and backup scripts, worker tuning, and monitoring.

name: profile_haproxy
description: Installs and configures HAProxy with backend fragments, error pages, statistics and credentials, firewall and service behavior, and optional node discovery.

name: profile_postgresql
description: Installs PostgreSQL using the configured package repository and versioned packages, and manages the database service.

name: profile_redis_cluster
description: Installs and configures Redis with cluster-oriented settings such as port, password, memory limits, and eviction policy, using PuppetDB-based node discovery.
